close_reason: Delivered in PR #246 (audited 2026-09-06: app env overrides static use-config, optional init/1; 6 precedence tests; CI green)
description: Bedrock.Cluster static `use` config currently takes precedence over the otp_app application environment; convention (Ecto/Phoenix/Oban) is the reverse: `use` holds compile-time identity/defaults, app env overrides at runtime (runtime.exs must work without recompiling), optionally with an init/1 callback for last-mile adjustment. Surfaced while writing a full-cluster test that couldn't inject per-run paths via put_env.

title: App env should override static use-config (Ecto-style init pattern)
